messages:
maya (PM): Quick sync — ACME escalated: they need a Console view showing per-customer economics + error drilldowns for their pilot next week. We have one sprint to decide MVP scope.
eli (eng-obs): TL;DR of asks: hourly per-route cost, ability to filter by customer tag, error slices by model+route, and trace links for failed requests.
rachel (solutions): Sales says no pilot without a per-customer card they can screenshot. A synthetic demo could be acceptable short-term.
vika (design): I made a compact econ card that fits the overview page and has a customer/demo toggle. Preview: https://redwood.internal/figma/econ-card (will upload frames).
maya (PM): Suggestion for scope: MVP = per-route hourly cost + error counts + sampled trace links (7d retention). Follow-up = accurate per-customer attribution, extended retention, trace replay UX. Thoughts?
nate (infra): Reality check: true per-customer requires tagging at ingest (customer_id) and extra indexes; storage and aggregation costs go up. We can fake demo rows for ACME. Near-real-time agg (5-10m) is doable.
kevin (data): Cost attribution approach: token_count * model_unit_cost + constant infra overhead. We'll expose assumptions in tooltip and an "estimation confidence" note.
eli (eng-obs): Implementation plan (high level): 1) route+hour aggregator (nate/kevin) 2) metrics API for Console (eli) 3) trace sampling flag + link support (nate) 4) UI tile & filters (vika) 5) docs + demo dataset (maya/rachel). Default trace sampling 2%.
vika (design): UX acceptance criteria: 1) time-range filter, 2) customer/demo toggle, 3) click-to-see top error slices, 4) click opens trace pane. Can deliver prototype mid-sprint.
rachel (solutions): Request: can we export a CSV snapshot of the synthetic per-customer view for ACME's sales deck? They asked for a table.
maya (PM): Yes — we can generate a demo CSV and label it clearly as synthetic/demo data. That should hold until we ship true attribution.
opsbot: deploy-bot: obs-agg-v2 job queued. Canary scheduled in ~90m.
eli (eng-obs): Risks to call out: sampling can miss rare flaky errors; synthetic customer rows may set wrong expectations — add prominent disclaimers. Will log tech-debt for per-customer work with cost estimate.
maya (PM): Launch criteria (MVP): - visible econ card with per-route hourly cost - error counts by route (4xx/5xx + top messages) - sampled trace-id link for error spikes - demo CSV available for customers - docs/tooltips with assumptions. If any absent, mark feature as "beta" in UI.
nate (infra): Ballpark infra impact: ingestion cost +10%, storage +6% for 7d retention. Ops can absorb this quarter.
kevin (data): I'll run a 7-day backfill to generate demo data and seed the card.
maya (PM): I'll update the roadmap doc, create customer communication, and share the demo link with ACME. Thanks team :thumbsup:
